summary: Form 6-K filed by PowerBank Corp (non-US, maps to a current report on Form 8-K) announces commercial operation of a 4.99 MW battery energy storage project in Ontario. The project secured a 22-year contract with the IESO at $1,221/MW per business day and is eligible for a 30% Clean Technology Investment Tax Credit. Financing is via a combined $28.1 million loan from RBC. No special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or capital return. Filing is a routine operational milestone and financing update.
